parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate plastic, typically around 13 cm long and 1 cm wide.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the user's ear and helps maintain the frame's position on the face.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a hinge connected to the base body, allowing folding and unfolding for storage and wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate plastic, typically around 13 cm long and 1 cm wide.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the user's ear and balances the frame on the face.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a hinge connected to the base body, allowing folding and unfolding for storage and wearing.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame Front)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame front of the eyeglasses, made of acetate plastic, holding the lenses and connecting both legs.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in place and rests on the user's nose bridge, providing the main structural support for the eyeglasses.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the legs rotate around its hinges.
